 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {value: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value in (1, 2)}
    r, c = points[1]
    tr, tc = points[2]
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    dr, dc = abs(tr - r), abs(tc - c)

    # Follow the diagonal until one coordinate is one cell short of its marker,
    # then finish along the other axis, stopping adjacent to the second marker.
    while dr > 1 and dc > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        dr -= 1
        dc -= 1
        out[r][c] = 3
    if dr > 1:
        while dr > 1:
            r += sr
            dr -= 1
            out[r][c] = 3
    elif dc > 1:
        while dc > 1:
            c += sc
            dc -= 1
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
"
}
